meta.semantics: exact_display_match: decoded mnemonic == HLASM mnemonic; same_encoding_display_variant: same bytes, SLEIGH prefers an extended/display name (e.g. BCR 7,2 -> bner); true_mismatch: bytes decode to a semantically different instruction (none found); nodecode: decoder rejects the bytes (none; invalid all-zero TRTO record removed)
